But on 25 March 2026 his Foreign Minister Roberto Álvarez and OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann signed a Memorandum of Understanding in Paris to launch the country’s first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy, with Abinader right there overseeing it. This is obviously another coordinated move by hidden elites and international institutions to tighten their grip on the Dominican Republic, using the usual anti-corruption excuse as cover while they really advance their agenda of control and narrative management.
